ok I have to rant about something and then I have a favor to ask.

there's a sticker shop called StickerBurrow Co selling a "Knife Moth Vinyl Decal" for $6.50 or 3 for $15. that's my moth. the switchblade moth off my september 13 flash sheet.

timeline so everyone can see it: I posted the sheet on aug 30, flash day was sept 13, and the moth went in the first hour. first piece of the day, first hour, first person in the door. I still have the original drawing and I have the post with the date on it. and the decal they uploaded is not "inspired by" my drawing, it's a straight scan of my linework. same crack in the blade, same wing pattern. they didnt even flip it. it's my art, traced right onto a vinyl file.

when I messaged them tonight their whole reply was "love your work!" and then "moths are a very common tattoo motif and we can't remove listings based on similarity alone." and then they told me that if I have a registered copyright I can send it through their support form. I dont have a registered copyright. I have a drawing, a dated post, and a client who paid for a one of one tattoo. thats it. thats the whole deal. flash is sold ONE time to ONE person. she paid for that design, it lives on her body, and I'm the one who gets paid. thats how tattooing works.

and the part thats making me actually angry: the person who got that tattoo first hour messaged me tonight asking if I was the one selling stickers of her tattoo. she thought I took her tattoo, turned it into merch, and was profiting off it. which is what happened, except I'm the one getting robbed. she trusted me to make her a one of one and I let her down without even doing anything.

can we talk about the "common motif" thing for a second. sure, moths are common. a moth is a motif. nobody owns the moth. but this isnt a moth, this is MY moth, with MY crack in MY blade and MY wing pattern, and the only way you get that is by taking my drawing. "our artists create original designs inspired by trending styles" is what they said about it. it isnt inspired by anything, its a photocopy with a price tag.

also lol at "send us a registered copyright." small shops dont have lawyer money and these sticker places know it. registering a copyright costs money and time that most artists working out of a chair dont have, and honestly most of us wont fight it because we cant afford to spend three weeks emailing a company with an actual legal team. thats why this keeps happening. because it works on us.

so here's the ask. if you see a "Knife Moth Vinyl Decal" listing at StickerBurrow Co, please report it for stolen artwork, and please dont buy from them. every platform has a copyright/IP complaint option right on the listing page or in their help section, its like a minute of clicking. every sale is money to a shop thats using my work without asking. if you already bought one, throw it out.

and to the person who got the moth tattooed: it was not me selling stickers of your tattoo. I dont make stickers. I dont sell my flash, ever, to anyone. sorry you had to run into this tonight, that tattoo is yours and only yours and I'm gonna fix this part.

if anybody has a horror story about a sticker shop or print shop lifting tattoo artists work, put it in the comments. I could use the ammunition.

ok. rant over. back to drawing.

hey, it's me. no, that sticker is not mine and I am not selling stickers of your tattoo. I dont make stickers at all and I have never sold or licensed that design to anybody.

what happened is a sticker shop called StickerBurrow Co took my original drawing off my flash sheet and is selling it as a "Knife Moth Vinyl Decal" for $6.50. same crack in the blade, same wing pattern, they didnt even flip it. when I messaged them they said moths are a common motif and told me to send a registered copyright through their support form.

I'm putting something up on my own page tonight about it and asking people to report the listing. I'm sorry you had to see it and think it was me, you have my word that's not what happened. that tattoo is a one of one and it was always just yours.
